vocabulary.meaning_en: a room or building where people work at desks
vocabulary.example: I get to the office at nine.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a room with a table and screens where a team meets
vocabulary.example: The project kick-off is in the meeting room.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the area near the entrance where visitors are welcomed
vocabulary.example: Please wait for me at reception.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a place in a building where people buy and eat food
vocabulary.example: We had lunch in the cafeteria.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a long passage inside a building that connects rooms
vocabulary.note_ar: في الأمريكي يُقال غالباً hallway، و corridor شائعة في الاثنين
vocabulary.example: His office is at the end of the corridor.
vocabulary.note_en: In American English people often say "hallway"; "corridor" is common in both British and American English.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small work space with low walls in an open office
vocabulary.example: She sits in the cubicle next to mine.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a table you work at
vocabulary.example: There are papers all over my desk.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a seat for one person
vocabulary.example: This office chair is very comfortable.

vocabulary.meaning_en: an electronic machine for working with information
vocabulary.example: Turn off your computer before you leave.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a small computer you can carry
vocabulary.example: Bring your laptops to the meeting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a machine that puts text and pictures on paper
vocabulary.example: The printer is out of paper.
vocabulary.note_en: print = to put words or pictures on paper with a machine.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a device for calling people
vocabulary.example: Her phone rang during the meeting.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a paper or digital file with important information
vocabulary.example: Please sign this document.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a cover or digital place where you keep files
vocabulary.example: Put everything in the shared folder.
vocabulary.note_en: shared folder = a folder that several people can use.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a set of papers or a computer document
vocabulary.example: I saved the file on my desktop.
vocabulary.note_en: As a verb, "file" means to store or organise documents.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the person with power who gives orders at work
vocabulary.example: I have a meeting with the boss at three.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who organises work and a team in one department
vocabulary.example: James is the office manager.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person you work with
vocabulary.example: My colleagues helped me with the report.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who welcomes visitors and answers the phone
vocabulary.example: The receptionist gave me a visitor card.
vocabulary.note_en: reception → receptionist (the person who works at reception).

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who organises appointments, emails and files for others
vocabulary.note_ar: الشركات الحديثة تسميها غالباً administrative assistant
vocabulary.example: Ask my secretary to book a meeting.
vocabulary.note_en: Modern companies often call this job "administrative assistant".

vocabulary.meaning_en: the modern name for a secretary
vocabulary.example: Our administrative assistant answers all the emails.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a student or new graduate who works for a short time to gain experience
vocabulary.note_ar: internship = فترة التدريب، وأحياناً تكون بدون أجر
vocabulary.example: We have two new interns this summer.
vocabulary.note_en: An internship is the training period, and sometimes it is unpaid.

vocabulary.meaning_en: when people come together to discuss something
vocabulary.example: The meeting starts at ten.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the final time to finish something, with serious results if you miss it
vocabulary.example: The deadline for the marketing file is Thursday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a planned piece of work with a goal
vocabulary.example: Our new project starts on Monday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a document that gives information about a subject
vocabulary.example: Emma will prepare the report.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a talk where someone explains ideas or results on a screen
vocabulary.example: Sarah will lead the team presentation.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a plan that shows the times of work and meetings
vocabulary.example: Let's stay on schedule this week.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a piece of work you must do
vocabulary.example: Each person has one task for today.

vocabulary.meaning_en: working well together as a group
vocabulary.example: Good teamwork makes the job easier.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a short official message sent inside a company
vocabulary.example: The manager sent a memo to all staff.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person or company that pays for a service
vocabulary.example: The client visits the office on Wednesday.

vocabulary.meaning_en: to give or upload finished work to the person who asked for it
vocabulary.example: Submit everything by 5 p.m.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the official start of a project or event
vocabulary.note_ar: من ضربة البداية في كرة القدم
vocabulary.example: The project kick-off is at 9 a.m.
vocabulary.note_en: From the kick that starts a football match.

vocabulary.meaning_en: relaxed, not official
vocabulary.example: Friday's session is informal but fun.

vocabulary.meaning_en: getting a lot of useful work done
vocabulary.example: Let's make this week productive.

vocabulary.meaning_en: the planned date when something should be paid or given
vocabulary.example: The due date for the phone bill is the 15th.

vocabulary.meaning_en: a person who inspires and guides a team
vocabulary.example: A good leader says "let's do it together".
vocabulary.note_en: lead = to guide or direct people.

fine_lines.title: due date vs deadline
fine_lines.explanation_ar: due date الموعد المخطط في التقويم لتسليم شيء أو دفع فاتورة عادية، وغالباً توجد فترة سماح بعده بدون عواقب فورية. deadline الموعد النهائي الحاسم، وتجاوزه يسبب مشكلة حقيقية أو فشلاً في المشروع.

examples.sentence: The due date for the electricity bill is the first of every month.
The team worked late to meet the project deadline.

fine_lines.explanation_en: A due date is the planned date in the calendar to hand something in or pay a normal bill; often there is some extra time after it with no serious result. A deadline is the final, critical date, and missing it causes a real problem or makes the project fail.

fine_lines.title: boss vs manager vs leader
fine_lines.explanation_ar: boss صاحب السلطة الرسمية الذي يملك القرار ويعطي الأوامر المباشرة. manager إداري متخصص ينظّم العمليات ويدير الموارد والمهام بكفاءة داخل قسم معين. leader الشخص الملهم الذي يبث الحماس في الفريق ويقوده نحو النجاح حتى لو لم يكن له منصب أعلى. يقال: الـ boss يقول «اذهبوا واعملوا»، والـ leader يقول «هيا نعمل معاً».

examples.sentence: The boss decided to open a new branch.
The sales manager organises the team's tasks.
She has the same job title as us, but she is the real leader of the team.

fine_lines.explanation_en: A boss has official power, makes decisions and gives direct orders. A manager is an organiser who runs processes and manages resources and tasks well inside a department. A leader inspires the team, makes people excited and guides them to success, even without a higher position. People say: a boss says "Go and work", but a leader says "Let's work together".

fine_lines.title: corridor vs hallway
fine_lines.explanation_ar: الاثنان بمعنى ممر داخل المبنى. hallway أشيع في الإنجليزية الأمريكية، و corridor شائعة في البريطانية والأمريكية خاصة في المباني الكبيرة كالمكاتب والمستشفيات.

examples.sentence: The meeting room is down the corridor on the left.
Leave your shoes in the hallway.

fine_lines.explanation_en: Both mean a passage inside a building. "Hallway" is more common in American English, and "corridor" is common in both British and American English, especially in large buildings like offices and hospitals.

expressions.meaning_ar: يتواصل بسرعة مع شخص للاطمئنان على سير العمل
expressions.example: Let's touch base tomorrow morning before the client meeting.
expressions.meaning_en: to contact someone quickly to check how the work is going

expressions.example: We will kick off the project on Monday.
Let's stay on schedule and finish by Friday.
expressions.meaning_en: to keep to the planned timetable

expressions.meaning_ar: يلتزم بالموعد النهائي ويسلّم في الوقت
expressions.example: We worked all night to meet the deadline.
expressions.meaning_en: to finish and hand in work on time

expressions.example: Sarah will lead the presentation on Tuesday.
expressions.meaning_en: to lead or give the presentation

expressions.example: My new job? I'm loving it!
expressions.meaning_en: I'm really enjoying it right now

grammar.title: State verbs in the continuous for a temporary feeling
grammar.explanation_ar: الكتب التقليدية تقول إن أفعال المشاعر مثل love و like أفعال حالة لا تأخذ ing. لكن في الإنجليزية المحكية الحديثة يستخدمها المتحدث الأصلي بصيغة الاستمرار ليقول إنه مستمتع بالتجربة الآن وبشكل مؤقت، وليس كحقيقة عامة ثابتة. لذلك اختارت ماكدونالدز شعار I'm lovin' it. الصيغتان صحيحتان، لكن الاستمرار يعطي إحساساً بالحماس اللحظي.
examples: I'm loving this marketing project. (enjoying it now)
How's your first day? I'm really liking it!
grammar.explanation_en: Traditional grammar books say that feeling verbs like "love" and "like" are state verbs and don't take -ing. But in modern spoken English, native speakers use them in the continuous form to say they are enjoying an experience right now, for a limited time, not as a general fact. That's why McDonald's chose the slogan "I'm lovin' it". Both forms are correct, but the continuous form gives a feeling of excitement in the moment.

questions.question: A small work space with low walls in an open office is a:

questions.explanation_en: A deadline is the critical date; missing it has serious results.

questions.explanation_en: An intern is a student or trainee who works for a short time to gain experience.

questions.question: "Let's touch base tomorrow" means:

questions.explanation_ar: leader الشخص الملهم الذي يقود الفريق.
questions.explanation_en: A leader is the person who inspires and guides the team.

questions.question: "I'm loving this project" means the speaker:
choices: is enjoying the project right now
questions.explanation_ar: الاستمرار مع love يعبّر عن استمتاع لحظي ومؤقت.
questions.explanation_en: "Love" in the continuous form shows enjoyment right now, for a limited time.

questions.explanation_en: Administrative assistant is the modern name.

questions.question: A short official message sent to all staff inside a company is a:
